name.en: GT2 16-tooth pulley, 6 mm belt, 5 mm bore
name.es: Polea GT2 de 16 dientes, banda de 6 mm, barreno de 5 mm
name.fr: Poulie GT2 à 16 dents, courroie de 6 mm, alésage de 5 mm
name.pt: Polia GT2 de 16 dentes, correia de 6 mm, furo de 5 mm

description.en: A flanged GT2 (2GT) timing pulley with 16 teeth for a 6 mm belt and a 5 mm set-screw bore, the size a NEMA 17 motor shaft takes. A commercial class: the tooth count, pitch, pitch diameter and bore are shared; the hub and flange dimensions are one maker's (MISUMI GPA, shape A). In a Voron 2.4-class Z drive it is the motor pulley of the 5:1 reduction.
description.es: Una polea síncrona GT2 (2GT) con pestañas, de 16 dientes para banda de 6 mm y barreno de 5 mm con prisioneros, la medida que toma la flecha de un motor NEMA 17. Una clase comercial: el número de dientes, el paso, el diámetro primitivo y el barreno son comunes; las medidas del cubo y las pestañas son de un fabricante (MISUMI GPA, forma A). En un accionamiento Z de clase Voron 2.4 es la polea del motor de la reducción 5:1.
description.fr: Une poulie crantée GT2 (2GT) à flasques, à 16 dents pour courroie de 6 mm et alésage de 5 mm à vis de pression, la taille que prend l'arbre d'un moteur NEMA 17. Une classe commerciale : le nombre de dents, le pas, le diamètre primitif et l'alésage sont communs ; les cotes du moyeu et des flasques sont celles d'un fabricant (MISUMI GPA, forme A). Dans un entraînement Z de classe Voron 2.4, c'est la poulie moteur de la réduction 5:1.
description.pt: Uma polia sincronizada GT2 (2GT) com flanges, de 16 dentes para correia de 6 mm e furo de 5 mm com parafusos de fixação, a medida do eixo de um motor NEMA 17. Uma classe comercial: o número de dentes, o passo, o diâmetro primitivo e o furo são comuns; as medidas do cubo e das flanges são de um fabricante (MISUMI GPA, forma A). Num acionamento Z de classe Voron 2.4 é a polia do motor da redução 5:1.

governing.designation: GT2 (2GT) 16-tooth timing pulley for 6 mm belt, 5 mm bore

sources.title: MISUMI High Torque Timing Pulleys, 2GT type (GPA□□GT2040 / GT2060 / GT2090), catalog page 1340 (2019 MX)
sources.supports: 2GT, pitch 2.0 mm. Number of teeth vs P.D./O.D.: 16 teeth P.D. 10.19, O.D. 9.68; 20 teeth P.D. 12.73, O.D. 12.22. Belt width 6 mm (GPA□□GT2060): A 7.0, W 10.3, L 18.0; belt width 9 mm (GPA□□GT2090): A 10.0, W 13.3, L 21.0 (A shape: the hub, then the flanged toothed section W, 1.65 each side of A). Shaft bore 5 (H7) with M3 tapped holes and M3 x 3 set screws.

sources.supports: p. 38 (Z Drives and Idlers, Z drive): a GT2 16-tooth pulley on each Z NEMA 17 motor — the only 16-tooth pulleys in the printer; p. 34: the GT2 188 mm belt loop it drives

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of end face A, the hub end, on the bore axis. +z runs along the bore through the hub and then the flanged toothed section to end face B, the flange end, at z = 18 (MISUMI GPA, 6 mm belt, shape A: L 18, W 10.3). The belt's mid-plane is the middle of the toothed section, z = 12.85. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the pulley is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry.

pitch_diameter.note: MISUMI P.D. for 16 teeth; Gates 2MR-16S gives 0.401 in (source 1) = 10.19 mm, and 16 × 2 / π = 10.19

toothed_section_width.note: MISUMI W: the toothed width plus 1.65 each side

belt_midplane_from_face_a.note: derived: L − W/2 (shape A is the hub, L − W = 7.7, then the toothed section W with the belt centred in it)

set_screw.note: M3 x 3 set screws for the 5 mm bore

label.en: Bore at the hub end (face A)
label.es: Barreno en el extremo del cubo (cara A)
label.pt: Furo no lado do cubo (face A)

interfaces.note: Female: the bore takes the shaft hub end first. Framed at face A (the hub end), normal −z out of that face, so a shaft framed where face A lands, its normal toward the pulley, puts the pulley beyond it. The bore carries the NEMA 17 shaft's key: on a motor, the shaft's shaft_seat_mm is where this face lands.

label.en: Bore at the flange end (face B)
label.es: Barreno en el extremo de la pestaña (cara B)
label.pt: Furo no lado da flange (face B)

interfaces.note: Female: the same bore entered flange end first (the pulley turned round). Framed at face B, z = 18, normal +z out of that face.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Belt engagement (for ASM-1 §9 belt paths, lifted into belt_engagement when that block exists): pitch_diameter 10.19 mm, centre (0, 0, 12.85), axis (0, 0, 1); the mid-plane is derived from MISUMI's L and W, not a single cited number. Voron 2.4r2 (p. 38) mounts it on the Z motor; the commons z-drive-housing puts it flange end first (bore_b) so its mid-plane meets the 80-tooth pulley's.
